Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned counsel for the informant and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.

2. The petitioner seeks regular bail in connection with Darbhanga Cyber P.S. Case No.31 of 2023,
lodged on 01.08.2023, under Sections 420/376/471/474 of the Indian Penal Code and under Section 67A of I.T. Act, 2000.

entities.text: Darbhanga Cyber P.S. Case No.31 of 2023
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 3. As per the prosecution, the accused who is holder of a particular mobile number used to call the informant in a hotel, committed rape and at a subsequent time started putting pressure to the informant to call her daughter also otherwise threatened to make the photographs of the informant viral.
Upon disobey, the accused has made the video viral and thereafter the present case has been filed.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.5785 of 2024(3) dt.16-04-2024 4.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is innocent and has committed no offence.
Counsel submits that antecedent of the petitioner is clean.

He is in custody since Gajendra Patel @ Amit Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/11255606/
1 20.08.2023.

entities.text: Gajendra Patel @ Amit Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Counsel submits that it is not the petitioner rather the informant herself make the picture viral.
5. Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer for bail and submits that it is on the basis of the argument this Hon'ble Court on the previous occasion called for the case- diary.
6. Learned counsel for the informant vehemently opposed the prayer for bail and submits that the allegation made is absolutely correct and true.
Any prudent lady shall not accept such type of demand of anyone.

7. Upon perusal of the case-diary, it transpires that a certificate has been filed by the Sub-Inspector Incharge Cyber Branch, under Section 65B, who supported the allegation of the informant made in the FIR.
8. In this background, this Court is not inclined to grant bail to the petitioner.
Accordingly, the prayer for regular bail of the petitioner is hereby rejected.

(Dr. Anshuman, J) Mkr./-
